item.title: Airbnbs? DeLand isn’t ready to decide
item.description: DeLand is going to have to wait a bit to find out whether short-term rentals (STRs) will be able to operate legally in the city. City commissioners say they need more information before deciding whether — and how — to change DeLand’s law to allow them.
